chunks: And it has been narrated from ʿAmr ibn Qays al-Māṣir, who said:
I entered upon Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام in al-Madīnah, and before him was a dining spread, and he was eating. So I said to him: What is the proper etiquette of this dining spread?
He said: When you place it, mention Allah, and when you lift it, praise Allah, and clean up what is around the dining spread, for this is its proper etiquette.
He said: Then I turned, and there was a jug set down, so I said to him: What is the proper etiquette of the jug?

He said: Drink from the side nearest to its lip, and mention Allah, Mighty and Majestic. Then when you lift it away from your mouth, praise Allah, Mighty and Majestic. And beware of the place of the handle, that you drink from it, for it is the seat of Satan. This is its proper etiquette.

key_terms.حَدُّ: the proper limit, rule, or etiquette of a thing
key_terms.خِوَانٌ: a dining spread or tablecloth from which food is eaten
key_terms.شَفَتَيْهِ: its lip or rim from which one drinks
key_terms.فَسَمِّ: say the name of Allah before beginning
key_terms.مَقْعَدُ الشَّيْطَانِ: the place described as the seat of Satan

ai.seo_question: What is the Islamic etiquette for a dining spread and drinking vessel according to Imam al-Baqir عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches the etiquette of eating and drinking by beginning with the name of Allah and ending with His praise. It also includes practical manners regarding the dining spread and the jug, showing that everyday acts are governed by remembrance of Allah and refined conduct.
